description.value: Marriott Pinnacle Downtown is a full-service hotel in Vancouver's downtown core, offering free WiFi and wheelchair accessibility. As a major international chain hotel, it provides standard accommodation services for traveling cyclists. Visitors should contact the hotel directly to discuss secure bike storage and handling of touring equipment.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 7m. Total: 2 spaces.
